hero_prompt: Wide risograph print, two-color (deep ink blue and warm amber), a drum machine grid on the left with rigid square beats stamped in a perfect row; on the right the same beats shown as a hand-drawn waveform with gentle timing variations, the two sides bleeding into each other at center; no letters, numerals, words, labels — purely pictorial.
icon_prompt: Bold square emblem, high contrast black on cream, a single thick grid line with one note circle sitting slightly off the intersecting point — implying snap but not landed; no fine linework, no letters, numerals, words, labels — purely pictorial.

title: Reverb ↔ Space-Time
idiom: Haeckel-style scientific engraving crossed with architectural cross-section ink drawing
hero_prompt: Wide darkened backdrop. A cathedral cross-section rendered in fine Haeckel engraving style — ink lines only, no colour. Sound waves radiate from a single point source near the floor; each successive reflection arrives at a listener figure (gender-neutral, abstract) with a numbered time label in milliseconds. The reflections form concentric arcs that also read as spacetime light-cones. The geometry of the room IS the geometry of the delay lines. One dominant figure dwells inside the sound field, not observing it. No letters, numerals, words, labels — purely pictorial.
icon_prompt: Bold high-contrast square emblem. A single sound-wave arc doubling as a spacetime light-cone — thick clean lines, no fine detail, no text, no numerals. Black on off-white or white on deep charcoal. Must survive at 24px. No letters, no labels, purely pictorial.

title: Saturation ↔ Richness
idiom: Haeckel-style scientific engraving — a precise technical diagram rendered with the warmth of a 19th-century naturalist plate
hero_prompt: Wide 12:5 format, dark sepia-toned background. A Haeckel-style scientific engraving showing a single clean waveform on the left transforming rightward into a rich harmonic stack — like a tree of overtones branching upward from a single root frequency. The lines are hand-engraved, precise yet organic, with fine crosshatching giving depth to the harmonic branches. At center a glowing tube filament suggests warmth at the threshold. Balanced group of a woman and a man at laboratory instruments in the foreground, rendered in the same engraving style. No letters, numerals, words, labels — purely pictorial.
icon_prompt: Bold high-contrast square emblem on near-black background: a single thick waveform line on the left that fans into three thicker harmonic arcs on the right, like a river delta. No fine linework — all strokes at least 3px equivalent. Warm amber or golden tones on black. No letters, numerals, words, labels.

title: Learning Materials and Canon
idiom: Gorey ink crosshatch
hero_prompt: Edward Gorey ink crosshatch illustration, wide darkened backdrop, a tall ornate gate standing open in a fog-draped landscape — one side shows a garden of neatly ordered cards and books lit from within, the other side shows loose scrolls and posters drifting in wind; a single slender figure stands at the threshold with a quill, making a mark on the gateposts; no letters, numerals, words, labels — purely pictorial
icon_prompt: Bold high-contrast square emblem in Gorey ink style — a heavy gate latch or bolt drawn as a thick black bar with a small keyhole, set on stark white, no fine linework, no letters, numerals, words, or labels — survives at 24px

title: Worktree Practice
idiom: woodcut print
hero_prompt: Wide darkfield woodcut print, deep indigo ground. A central image: a single gnarled oak tree in a cleared field, its root system visible below the soil line, each root ending in a separate torch flame. Above ground the trunk rises alone into a dark sky — one trunk, one crown. Several smaller saplings stand in a ring around it at a distance, each on its own patch of earth, their own root systems isolated but their crowns beginning to incline toward the central tree. No letters, numerals, words, labels — purely pictorial. Hard woodcut lines, high contrast, no photographic texture.
icon_prompt: Bold square woodcut emblem on near-black ground: a thick central vertical trunk bisected by a horizontal line — above the line one branch crown, below it three separated root bundles spreading outward. Maximum contrast, no fine linework, no letters, numerals, words, or labels — purely pictorial, survives at 24px.
